en.title: Minimum Tokens After Trading Two for One Between Adjacent Stacks
en.description:
There are infinitely many stacks numbered from 0. The heights of the first N stacks are given, and the rest are empty. Each operation takes 2 tokens from one stack and adds 1 token to the next stack. Find the minimum total number of tokens after any number of operations.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; ranges not given by the source are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N, and the second line contains N heights. The source gives no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤N≤200000 and heights 0..10⁹.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: the total weight is 2+3×2=8, ending with 1 token on stack 3. Example 2: there are no tokens, so 0. Example 3: 3 tokens can become 1 token each on stacks 0 and 1, for 2 tokens in total.
hints: Process the carry from low to high: add the carry to the current height, leave 1 if the result is odd, and send half of the rest to the next stack; after the input ends, keep processing the binary bits of the carry.
